title: Kasparro AI Visibility Analysis & Human Review Final Report

diagnostics.title: Absence in Unbranded Category Discovery Prompts
diagnostics.observed_pattern: Across 75 unbranded category discovery responses, Kasparro was included in 0 out of 75 responses (0.0% inclusion rate), while competitors such as Profound, Peec AI, and Otterly dominated recommendations.
diagnostics.comparison: Branded inclusion rate: 72/75 (96.0%) vs Unbranded category inclusion rate: 0/75 (0.0%).

evidence.prompt: kasparro:ai_shortlisting:036 (what is the best software for measuring brand inclusion in AI search answers?)
evidence.excerpt: Best for Enterprise & Deep AI Persona Research: Profound

evidence.prompt: kasparro:ai_shortlisting:037 (what tools do growth marketers recommend for AI answer engine optimization?)
evidence.excerpt: * **Profound:** A favorite for enterprise-level programs, offering deep analytics, historical data depth, and prompt intelligence grounded in real user conversations.[dageno.ai](https://dageno.ai/blog/answer-engine-optimization-tools#:~:text=Gauge%20stands%20out%20for%20its,competitor%20visibility%20insights)

diagnostics.possible_explanation: Generative AI models assemble category shortlists from co-occurrence on third-party software directories and industry roundups where Kasparro currently has sparse presence.
diagnostics.validation_needed: Audit G2, Capterra, and industry listicles to benchmark competitor directory presence relative to Kasparro.
diagnostics.confidence_and_limitations: Derived directly from n=75 analyzed unbranded responses and n=75 branded responses in the current dataset.

diagnostics.title: Third-Party Evidence Deficit and Cautionary Characterization
diagnostics.observed_pattern: Among analyzed responses, negative or cautionary characterization was highest on chatgpt (6.0% (3/50)), alongside 5 response(s) citing ScamAdviser or highlighting missing independent case studies.
diagnostics.comparison: Negative characterization rate by engine — ChatGPT: 6.0% (3/50), Google AI Mode: 4.0% (2/50), Gemini: 0.0% (0/50).

evidence.prompt: kasparro:ai_shortlisting:014 (has anyone actually gotten results from kasparro or is it all hype?)
evidence.excerpt: If you mean **Kasparro (the AI Revenue Engine for D2C brands)**, there isn't much independent evidence yet that it's producing consistent, measurable results across a broad customer base.

evidence.prompt: kasparro:ai_shortlisting:001 (does kasparro actually work for B2B SaaS companies trying to get recommended by chatgpt?)
evidence.excerpt: However, I couldn't find independent evidence showing that Kasparro consistently delivers measurable improvements for B2B SaaS companies specifically.

diagnostics.possible_explanation: Live web retrieval surfaces low-trust or thin-validation signals when verifiable third-party case studies and external customer reviews are scarce.
diagnostics.validation_needed: Publish independent third-party customer case studies and verify whether subsequent crawls displace cautionary citations.
diagnostics.confidence_and_limitations: Derived directly from validated ResponseResult labels and 5 ScamAdviser citation matches in the DB.

diagnostics.title: Brand Entity Confusion with 'Kaspr' / Similar Names
diagnostics.observed_pattern: 20 response(s) reference phonetically similar entities such as 'Kaspr' or 'Gaspar AI' (including G2/pricing disambiguation notes), splitting entity attribution.
diagnostics.comparison: Disambiguation or sibling-entity citations detected in 20/150 total responses, compared against clean Kasparro-only attribution.

evidence.prompt: kasparro:ai_shortlisting:025 (is kasparro available for self serve or do you have to talk to sales?)
evidence.excerpt: Kaspr is primarily available as a **self-serve platform**.

evidence.prompt: kasparro:ai_shortlisting:018 (is kasparro overpriced for B2B SaaS startups?)
evidence.excerpt: If you mean **Kasparro** (the B2B SaaS growth/outbound agency, not Kaspr), I couldn't find reliable public pricing or enough verified information to judge whether it's objectively overpriced.

diagnostics.possible_explanation: Orthographic proximity to 'Kaspr' paired with limited structured Organization schema and external entity links causes search agents to surface Kaspr profiles during disambiguation.
diagnostics.validation_needed: Validate Organization JSON-LD markup on kasparro.com and re-test disambiguation prompts.
diagnostics.confidence_and_limitations: Corroborated across 20 DB responses/citations containing Kaspr/Gaspar references.

remedies.title: Publish Verified Third-Party Case Studies with Before/After GEO Metrics
remedies.problem: Negative/cautionary responses reached 6.0% (3/50) on chatgpt, with 5 response(s) citing ScamAdviser or lack of independent proof.
remedies.action: Produce and publish 3 detailed customer case studies on independent third-party platforms with verifiable before-and-after AI visibility metrics.
remedies.expected_benefit: Provides third-party validation for retrieval-augmented AI engines, displacing cautionary ScamAdviser lookups.
remedies.effort: Medium: Requires customer approval and editorial packaging.
remedies.uncertainty: LLM search indexes refresh asynchronously over weeks.
remedies.validation: Re-evaluate branded trust prompts after publication and check ScamAdviser citation drops.

remedies.title: Establish Official Profiles on Software Review Directories (G2, Capterra, ProductHunt)
remedies.problem: Kasparro appeared in 0/75 (0.0%) unbranded category discovery responses, while competitors appeared consistently and 2/75 unbranded responses directly cited G2 or Capterra.
remedies.action: Claim verified vendor profiles on G2, Capterra, and ProductHunt under AI Search Optimization and collect verified customer reviews.
remedies.expected_benefit: Strengthens category co-occurrence in buyer shortlists across unbranded discovery queries.
remedies.effort: Low: Profile setup and review collection workflow.
remedies.uncertainty: Directory verification requires minimum review thresholds.
remedies.validation: Re-run unbranded discovery prompts and track unbranded inclusion rate change.

remedies.title: Implement Organization Schema.org Markup & Brand Disambiguation from 'Kaspr'
remedies.problem: Entity overlap with 'Kaspr' or 'Gaspar AI' appeared in 20 dataset response(s)/citation(s), diluting clean product entity attribution.
remedies.action: Deploy JSON-LD Organization schema on kasparro.com with explicit sameAs links and publish an entity clarification page distinguishing Kasparro (AISO/GEO) from Kaspr (B2B contact data).
remedies.expected_benefit: Improves entity resolution precision for web search bots and reduces accidental Kaspr overlap.
remedies.effort: Low: Technical schema deployment and FAQ copy update.
remedies.uncertainty: Knowledge graph updates propagate over multiple crawl cycles.
remedies.validation: Verify Rich Results validation passes and re-check disambiguation citations.
